title: Chapter 1473 - 14: An Ant Beholds The Heavens

Chapter 1473 - 14: An Ant Beholds The Heavens

Chapter 1473: Chapter 14: An Ant Beholds the Heavens

"Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao!"

At this moment, propelled by the four types of Chaotic Origin Dao, the last Chaotic Origin Dao, evolved from the "Innate Five Great," has been completely formed.

Chaotic Origin Tai Yi Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Chu Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Shi Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao, and Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao rapidly fused, and a ’new’ Dao began to emerge.

Climbing the white jade steps for over twenty thousand years, Lin Yuan was just one step away from enlightening the Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao, with all his accumulation reaching its pinnacle, yet he could never take that step. Now, under the threat of terrifying entities from different times and spaces, he finally achieved his wish.

"Fusion."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts moved slightly.

The five types of Chaotic Origin Dao quickly fused together.

More accurately, it was the Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao merging into the previous four types of Chaotic Origin Dao.

Like a map missing a corner, it was completely filled, achieving perfection without any flaws.

"This..." Lin Yuan immersed his entire mind into the newly born Dao. The ’new’ Dao was formed by the fusion of five types of Chaotic Origin Dao, standing above numerous Chaotic Origin Daos, even having a hint of the Supreme Rule Dao.

As soon as the new ’Dao’ was born, it began to nurture Lin Yuan, nourishing everything about him—his physical body, soul, psyche, and will, etcetera. All his true bodies, main body, avatars, as long as it was Lin Yuan, were enhancing at an inconceivable speed.

"Boom～～～" Lin Yuan’s consciousness roared, his body, soul, and psyche surged rapidly, causing him to momentarily let go of his attention to the outside world.

...

Located in the Chaos Void.

This area has thoroughly become a battlefield aimed at subduing Lin Yuan. Over five hundred terrifying entities from different times and spaces began a desperate fight, combined with their power being completely drawn together by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, the resulting power shook countless times and spaces of the past and future.

In fact, aside from over five hundred terrifying entities from different times and spaces, numerous Legendary Lords of the current time and space also participated.

Such as Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord.

Legendary Lords from other times and spaces desire the Supreme Rule Dao’s will to descend to prevent the galaxy’s catastrophe, with the starting threshold being surviving three billion catastrophes.

But the Legendary Lords of the current time and space only need to survive one billion catastrophes to participate in preventing the galaxy from climbing a new transcendent path in this catastrophe.

After over five hundred terrifying entities arrived, Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord led the charge forward, and numerous other Legendary Lords who survived a billion catastrophes followed.

With so many powerful Lords ahead, even if the final catastrophe failed, they could retreat unharmed.

This is the true thought of the numerous Legendary Lords of the current time and space who survived a billion catastrophes.

Failure means little loss, whereas success brings great benefits.

Hence...

Over ninety percent of the Legendary Lords who survived a billion catastrophes participated.

The number reached tens of thousands.

However, in suppressing the Galaxy Lord, tens of thousands of Legendary Lords who survived a billion catastrophes merely served as support.

The true main force comprised over five hundred terrifying entities from different times and spaces.

...

With Lin Yuan’s enlightenment of the Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao, the fusion of the five types of Chaotic Origin Dao into a new Dao rapidly nurtured him, his mind wholly immersed in the newly born Dao.

This consequently relaxed his defense against over five hundred terrifying entities from the outside world.

The invisible barrier formed by the outer universe began to dissipate, and numerous life-saving defense mechanisms gradually ceased operation.

"A good opportunity."

The terrifying entity releasing infinite radiance brightened its eyes.

Though it didn’t know why Lin Yuan was experiencing this phenomenon, it was undoubtedly a rare opportunity for them at the present moment.

Even though over five hundred terrifying entities were fighting for their lives, truly suppressing and handling Lin Yuan would still fall into a relatively prolonged stalemate.

But now.

Lin Yuan actually took the initiative to abandon defense? Isn’t this giving them an opportunity?

"Light of Origin!"

The terrifying entity releasing infinite radiance suddenly exploded, converging all its power into a brilliant line, this line trembled numerous spaces and times, and seeing this, other terrifying entities followed suit, unleashing truly desperate killing moves.

The forces of numerous killing moves, under the embrace of the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, completely fused, emitting a thoroughly condensed dark strike, sweeping toward Lin Yuan.

Without the defenses like the outer universe, this amalgamated dark strike from all terrifying entities and tens of thousands of Legendary Lords struck Lin Yuan’s physical body without obstruction.

"Hmm?"

Threads of radiance reassembled, the terrifying entity releasing infinite light was utterly shocked, watching Lin Yuan as if he gave up defending.

The gathered desperate killing move indeed landed on Lin Yuan but did not shake him a bit, the terrifying forces were absorbed, devoured, and vanished upon contact with Lin Yuan’s body.

"How is it possible?"

The terrifying entity releasing infinite light was incredulous, the fused dark strike was easily blocked like this? The Galaxy Lord’s defense mechanisms are so extraordinary?

If they were truly this extraordinary, how could the Galaxy Lord have behaved that way during their united assault and suppression just now?

"Hidden strength or a breakthrough in the moment?"

The terrifying entity releasing infinite light pondered, only these two possibilities could explain the current occurrence.

The entity inclined towards the former possibility, as achieving a breakthrough during battle is simply too incredible; the stronger the power, the higher the realm, the more rigorous the secluded environment needed for each breakthrough.
